# The Growth Union

> A strategy-led growth consultancy for MSMEs, startups and founders. Head office in Gurgaon, with an office in New Delhi (Saket). We serve clients in India, the UK, the US and worldwide.

## What we do
- Strategy and positioning, acquisition (ads, SEO, AEO), digital infrastructure, sales systems, legal and compliance, and hiring systems, under one roof.
- Fixed monthly packages: Foundation (Rs 35,000, or $375 outside India) and Growth (Rs 55,000, or $575), plus Custom. Prices exclude GST. Three-month minimum.
- 38 individual services, each with its own page and a stated price: SEO and AEO, social media, ads, influencer marketing, PR, websites, CRM, telecalling, sales management, legal assistance, recruitment and more. Prices exclude GST.
- A free 30-minute growth audit, led by founder Neeraj Grover.
